Containers.Name: FanControl Plus 2
Containers.Description: FanControl Plus 2 provides automatic fan speed control based on HDD, NVMe, Unassigned Devices, IPMI, and optional CPU temperatures, with fully customizable fan-to-sensor mapping and UI. Fork of FanCtrl Plus by ck9393.
Containers.DonateText: This is a fork — donations go to ck9393, the original author of FanCtrl Plus.
